temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn and down than usual; when Jose asks, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant and has not seemed troubled; Jose has no known reason to think she is struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose's initial suspicion that something is troubling Patricia is strengthened, but he learns she is not ready to disclose specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with personal problems; she appreciates his offer of support but is keeping the details private.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and somewhat relieved that she accepted his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without pushing her to share more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and responds positively to his offer to discuss financial planning/budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has some unspecified personal difficulty and appreciates support, but Jose does not know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: his concern deepens and he now identifies financial stress as a concrete source of her distress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is stressed by bills and financial commitments, and she is receptive to financial planning or budgeting help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, sympathy, and helpful motivation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer and be ready to discuss budgeting/financial planning support when Patricia feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying and says she is grateful he offered to help; Jose explains he respects her privacy and wants to support her as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries that Patricia might think he overstepped his boundaries by bringing up her financial situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: his worry is resolved by Patricia's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not think he pried and appreciates his support; he can help as a friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry/anxiety giving way to relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain respectful support, avoid prying, and remain available as a friend.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is good and she plans a quiet weekend at home; she responds politely but does not share more about her issues. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle things privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and does not think he overstepped, but Jose is still mindful of respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/confirms: Jose now more clearly believes Patricia values his concern but wants to manage her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers privacy and independence; light, respectful check-ins are appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, calm, and a desire not to intrude.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Stay friendly and supportive, check in lightly, and let Patricia know he is available without pressing her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is pretty busy but handling it, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately; Jose intends to remain supportive without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change, but it confirms and reinforces his belief that Patricia is managing and values his supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is coping with her situation in her own way and appreciates regular supportive check-ins; Jose can continue being a helpful colleague/friend.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Supportive, reassured, and glad to be able to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue maintaining a supportive presence, offer practical help if needed, and avoid prying.
